title: Order Position (Line Item)
description: A single line item on an order header. Requests exactly one of: a specific load unit, material by item id + quantity, or the output of an already-completed sub-order (used by consolidation orders spawned by a completion_rule). Splitting never mutates the original position - a split creates NEW positions on the sub-order(s) that reference the original via source_line_id, so the original order always shows what was actually ordered.

source_line_id.description: References the line_id this position was split from, on the (grand-)parent order. Absent on a top-level order's own positions.

load_unit_request.description: Request for a specific load unit rather than material by quantity (e.g. 'bring this exact pallet/bin').

load_unit_type.description: References an id in Warehouse-as-Code's elements/load_unit_types.yaml (candidate to move to MasterData-as-Code, see that repo's Shared Vocabulary section).

material_request.description: Request for material by item and quantity, independent of which load unit(s) it ends up coming from.

properties.description: Optional constraints on the material, e.g. batch/lot, minimum shelf life, hazmat class.

suborder_output_request.description: Consolidation position: 'take whatever this completed sub-order produced', rather than requesting fresh material. Used on orders spawned by a completion_rule's spawn_order action.

source_order_id.description: References the order_id of a (typically completed) sub-order.
